ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — MOCK EXAM #17
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   B. Skipping all moral lessons
   C. Refusing to help a neighbour
   D. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school

2. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Waste food daily
   B. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   C. Pollute rivers deliberately
   D. Destroy trees without planting

3. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on brushing teeth? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on brushing teeth.
   B. Use Hadith on brushing teeth to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Hadith on brushing teeth with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say Hadith on brushing teeth has no place in daily life.

4. Which response best shows understanding of Pillars of Swalah? (1 mark)

   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Pillars of Swalah.
   D. Say Pillars of Swalah has no place in daily life.

   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith of Prophet Muhammad as a model of good character..

   B. Cheating in exams
